description: German employment law, Germany only: 10 follow-up workflows for HR tasks (HR-Workflows), e.g. payroll input deadline, missing onboarding documents, sick leave with eAU and BEM, maternity protection, probation decision, fixed-term contract signed before start. Each shows the chain 'when ... then ...' with default days and roles. Use it as a template for your own reminders. Without kennung it lists all.
